title: Globe Word Puzzle
description: Spin the globe and solve 12 word puzzles.

title: Rovatics Racers
description: Race two computer cars through 5 levels. Dodge cones, grab ⚡ boosts, and win the Champion Cup.

title: Rovatics Sudoku
description: 10 ever-harder levels, clues, celebrations, friend challenges and a leaderboard.
